responsibility: This file manages gm2 lexical scopes and statement sequencing on top of GCC tree BLOCK and statement-list machinery. It owns the binding_level data structure for global and function scopes, tracks declarations, labels, types, constants, module-init functions, and nested statement lists, and provides the push/pop, declaration collection, block finalization, and statement-note hooks that other gm2 files use while constructing function bodies and global context trees.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation unit that owns the binding_level data structure and the actual scope/statement-list state transitions, including label lookup, declaration chaining, global constant retention, and statement-note flushing. The .h and .def files only expose those services as interfaces.
